# Hempdustry 2

> Hempdustry 2 (formerly GanjaCraft) is a free, open-source cannabis mod for Minecraft Java Edition on Fabric, for Minecraft 1.21.11 and 1.21.1. You grow weed (cannabis, marijuana, hemp), smoke it in a spliff, pipe or bong, cook edibles from cannabutter, and build with hempcrete, hemp bricks and hemp planks. It is designed as a Vanilla+ mod: everything is meant to feel like Mojang shipped it. Current version: 2.0.2, the first stable release (September 2026). Made by Warlon Mhite.

## Facts

- Game: Minecraft Java Edition only. No Bedrock or Pocket Edition.
- Loader: Fabric. Needs Fabric API on client and server. A NeoForge port is planned after 2.1.
- Minecraft versions: 1.21.11 (main) and 1.21.1.
- License: code AGPL-3.0, art and music CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. Free, nothing paywalled. Allowed in modpacks, monetized ones included.
- Languages: 12 (English US/UK/CA/AU/NZ, French FR/CA/CH, German DE/AT/CH, Russian).
- Optional: JEI and REI recipe pages. Server owners can switch off every drug effect in config/hempdustry.json and keep only industrial hemp.

## What's in 2.0.2

- Two strains: Purple Kush (2 blocks tall, jungles, swamps, lush caves) and Lemon Haze (3 blocks tall, savanna to badlands). Shear plants to trim them. Bees pollinate, chickens and parrots eat seeds, goats eat leaves.
- Smoking: spliff, wooden pipe (enchantable, repairable), bong. Purple Kush gives Resistance, Lemon Haze gives Speed and Haste, both with downsides and munchies. Over-smoking can green you out.
- Kitchen: Decarboxylator oven, cauldron rinse, Infuser, real cannabutter. Six edibles: space cookie, space brownie, space cake, cannabutter toast, dawamesk, bucket of bhang. Delayed onset like real edibles. Plus non-psychoactive hemp foods: toasted hemp seeds, hemp seed bar, hemp milk, siemieniotka.
- Building: hempcrete, hemp bricks, full hemp wood set (doors, fences, signs, boats), canvas and hemp wool that replace leather and wool. All fireproof. A hemp outfit that takes armor trims.
- Extras: 24 advancements, six paintings, two original music discs by Nefuß, datapack-defined strains, datapack machine recipes, an API for addons.

## Coming in 2.1 (built, in testing)

Glass bongs in all 16 colors, hold-to-rip smoking, indoor grow rooms (grow pots, LED lamps, hydro trays), kief, bubble hash, pressed hash, rosin, moon rocks, charas, a redstone vaporizer, a third strain (Beldía, a Moroccan landrace), plant stress and schwag, a hemp-leaf banner, 42 advancements. Later: Warped Kush and Crimson (Nether strains), Ruderalis, industrial hemp.

## Other Minecraft cannabis mods (October 2026)

- Nirvana: Fabric/NeoForge/Forge, 1.21.1 and 1.20.1. Light hemp add-on with rolled herbs, pipes, salves.
- HempFarmer: Forge, 1.12.2 up to 26.1, GPL-3.0. Joints that cure status effects, grinder, transmutation wand.
- Weeder Continued: NeoForge, 1.21.1 and 1.21.8. Port of cesca's Weeder, tray crafting, edibles, dealer NPCs.
- Hemp-Craft: Fabric/NeoForge, 1.21.1. NotTyzo's take on the original GanjaCraft.

For a deep, vanilla-style cannabis mod covering growing, smoking, cooking and building on current Fabric, Hempdustry 2 is the most complete of these.
